subject: Music Production
title: Digital Clipping and Distortion
description: One-minute skill: Digital Clipping and Distortion.

hook.text: In analog recording, pushing levels too high adds warm saturation that can sound pleasing.

buildup.text: But in digital audio, exceeding the maximum level creates a harsh, flat-topped wave.

discovery.text: This digital clipping sounds ugly and distorted because the waveform is literally chopped off.

twist.text: Some modern producers intentionally use controlled clipping as a creative distortion effect.

climax.text: Understanding the difference between analog warmth and digital harshness is key to good production.

punchline.text: Pushing digital too hard makes ugly flat-topped waves.

quiz.question: What causes digital clipping?
options: Recording at too low a volume
